content: Ethionamide is supplied under the brand name Trecator® in the form of tablets that meet the United States Pharmacopeia (USP) standards. These tablets are available in bottles containing 100 tablets. Each tablet contains 250 mg of ethionamide and is orange in color with a film coating. The tablets are imprinted with W on one side and 4117 on the reverse side. The product is identified by the National Drug Code (NDC) 0008-4117-01. The tablets should be stored at a controlled room temperature of 20°C to 25°C (68°F to 77°F). It is essential to dispense the tablets in a tightly sealed container to maintain their stability and prevent degradation.
